entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to make a return, I think. I'm a bit lost with the process. I have this helmet I ordered.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yes, let me find it... it's VF-8675309.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered about 74 days ago. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, um, a preference, I suppose? I just... the color isn't right. It looked different on the website, and I'm just so overwhelmed with it. The box is still unopened, I never even took it out. The whole return page on your site was confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely take care of this for you. There's no need to worry. Let me just confirm the return policy for this item.
Okay, I've checked for you, and I have good news. Since your helmet was delivered within the last 90 days, it's fully eligible for a return and a full refund.
Oh, it is? That's such a relief. I was so worried I had missed the deadline. Thank you.

You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied, especially with something as important as safety equipment. Since the box is unopened, the process will be very simple. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file for you right now. Do you have access to a printer?
Yes, I do. So I just print it and stick it on the box?

That's correct. Just attach that label to the original shipping box and drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll process your full refund. It should appear back on your card in 3-5 business days.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much for making that easy, David.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
